facts.fact: UNHCR RIMAP states Madagascar has no operational asylum system, the Office for Refugees and Stateless Persons has never been established in practice, and refugees and asylum seekers receive no formal protection or legal status.
facts.system: Office for Refugees and Stateless Persons

systems.system: Office for Refugees and Stateless Persons
systems.tiers: legally created 1962, never established in practice

note: No refugees or displaced people mentioned.
A bureau and a bill are institutional; counts of 89 refugees and about 1,200 asylum seekers state no registration or documents.
